properties.name: EnableSdkContainerSupport
properties.doc: dotnet publish /t:PublishContainer for a project that is not a web one.

properties.name: ContainerBaseImage
properties.doc: The base image; by default the runtime or aspnet image of the target framework.

properties.name: ContainerFamily
properties.doc: The flavor of the default base image.

properties.name: ContainerRegistry
properties.doc: The registry the image is pushed to; the local daemon when empty.

properties.name: ContainerRepository
properties.doc: The name of the image; the assembly name by default.

properties.name: ContainerImageTag
properties.doc: The tag of the image; latest by default.

properties.name: ContainerRuntimeIdentifier
properties.doc: The platform of the image, linux-x64 by default.

properties.name: ContainerRuntimeIdentifiers
properties.doc: Semicolon-separated platforms of a multi-architecture image.

properties.name: ContainerWorkingDirectory
properties.doc: The working directory of the container, /app by default.

properties.name: ContainerUser
properties.doc: The user the application runs as; app (non-root) in the images of .NET 8+.

properties.name: ContainerImageFormat
properties.doc: The format of the image manifest.

properties.name: ContainerArchiveOutputPath
properties.doc: Write the image as a tar.gz instead of pushing it.

properties.name: LocalRegistry
properties.doc: The local tool the image is loaded into.

properties.name: DockerDefaultTargetOS
properties.doc: The OS of the Dockerfile of the Visual Studio container tools.

properties.name: DockerfileContext
properties.doc: The build context of the Dockerfile, relative to the project.

items.name: ContainerPort
items.doc: A port the container exposes; Include is the number.

items.name: ContainerEnvironmentVariable
items.doc: An environment variable of the container; Include is the name.

items.name: ContainerLabel
items.doc: A label of the image; Include is the name.

items.name: ContainerAppCommand
items.doc: The entry point of the container instead of the application.

items.name: ContainerAppCommandArgs
items.doc: Arguments that always go with the entry point.

items.name: ContainerDefaultArgs
items.doc: Arguments a docker run without arguments gets.
